citation: Horie I, Abiru N, Eto M, et al. Sex differences in insulin and glucagon responses for glucose homeostasis in young healthy Japanese adults. Journal of Diabetes Investigation. 2018.
protocol: 75 g OGTT (Trelan-G75) after overnight fast; samples 0, 30, 60, 90, 120 min
population: n=63 (38 M, 25 F); age 24.4+/-1.9 (M), 25.4+/-2.5 (F) y; BMI 21.4 (M), 20.1 (F); healthy Japanese adults, NGT, BMI<=25
note: Best-in-class healthy OGTT: three pulse markers at five times in one table, split by sex. Insulin is IRI (uU/mL), glucagon IRG (pg/mL).
